# Request-Path Seam-View Benchmark Baseline (Wave 0 Pre-Consolidation)
# Task: 1.6 Capture request-path seam-view benchmark baselines
# Requirements: 7.1 (Hot-path neutrality, allocs/op <= baseline, zero new locks/key-searches)
#
# Machine-Context Caveat:
#   Captured on Windows 10/11 x86_64 (AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor @ windows/amd64).
#   Absolute ns/op measurements are hardware-, OS-, and CPU-frequency-dependent;
#   they are comparable only on the same machine class and execution environment.
#   B/op and allocs/op allocations are deterministic Go runtime metrics.
#
# Seam-View Accessor Defensive-Cloning Inventory:
#   1. Defensive-Cloning Accessors (allocate 1 alloc/op on non-empty data):
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).CompletionGates() [slices.Clone]
#      - CompletionGatesFromContext(ctx, fallback) [delegates to CompletionGates(); 0 alloc/op when empty/nil via emptyCompletionGates]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).TrafficPortBundle() [calls TrafficRedactors(), incurring 1 alloc/op when redactors non-empty; 0 when empty/nil]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).TrafficRedactors() [slices.Clone]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).SecretGuardPlane() [slices.Clone on Guards slice]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).CompactionObservers() [slices.Clone]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).CompactionPreservers() [slices.Clone]
#
#   2. Direct / Execution / Non-Cloning Accessors (0 alloc/op, zero-copy hot path):
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).SecretGuardExecutionPlane() [returns SecretGuardPlane directly without cloning Guards slice]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).TrafficObserver() [direct interface return]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).RawCapture() [direct interface return]
#      - (*RequestRuntimeSnapshot).TerminalDecisionProvider() [direct interface return]
#
# Issue #394 Performance Hardening Coordination:
#   - OBSERVE scenario: Evaluates traffic observation pipelines (TrafficPortBundle, RawCapture, TrafficObserver, TrafficRedactors).
#     Populated TrafficPortBundle incurs 1 alloc/op due to defensive cloning of redactors (32 B/op).
#   - DELTA-allocation scenario: Evaluates streaming turn / event processing reads (CompletionGatesFromContext,
#     SecretGuardExecutionPlane, CompactionObservers, CompactionPreservers).
#     Hot-path execution accessors such as SecretGuardExecutionPlane exhibit 0 alloc/op, whereas defensive-copy
#     accessors incur 1 alloc/op (16-32 B/op).
#     Post-consolidation implementations must maintain <= baseline allocs/op on all corresponding seams.
#   - HOLD scenario: Fixed-cost snapshot retention for idle / held streams. Snapshot accessors perform
#     zero background allocation, acquire zero mutexes/locks, and execute in O(1) time without map/key lookups.
#
# Captured Benchmark Output (Run 2 of 2):
